items.difficulty_reason: The category of differential graded modules is abelian and the forgetful functor to graded modules is exact and conservative: the forgetful target already has the five listed properties (lemma-gm-abelian), kernels and cokernels of homogeneous maps are equipped with the induced differential, composition is checked to be zero through the graded computation, and exactness of filtered colimits is transferred along the exact functor F. Retained author proof at lines 1466-1509.
